label: OPEN, analyst formulation from ST I q.19 a.1 with q.14 a.1, attribution…, from understanding
meaning: Whatever has intellect is in act through some intelligible form, through actual understanding as the middle term: whatever has intellect understands something (OPEN and contested: the human possible intellect before learning is a counterexample), and whatever understands something is in act through an intelligible form (OPEN q.14 a.2 / q.85 a.2 reading). The contested point of the target (power versus act of intellect) is isolated in the first premise.
